description: Python's serialization format, used by traditional PyTorch checkpoints. Loading it can call any Python function, so an untrusted file can execute code.
A tensor file format with a JSON header and raw bytes: nothing to execute, fast to load. The default format on the Hugging Face Hub.
A loading option that runs Python files from the model repository. Equivalent to executing a third-party script.
Re-registering a deleted author's name to serve a malicious model to pipelines that load by name. Defeated by pinned hashes and mirrors.
Cryptographic signatures over model files proving who produced them; the OpenSSF model-signing project uses Sigstore.
Hidden behavior trained into the weights that activates on a trigger. Invisible to file scanners; addressed with provenance and evals.
AI bill of materials: models, adapters and datasets with publisher, revision, hashes, base model, license and training data (CycloneDX ML-BOM, SPDX 3.0 AI profile).
